text:
Rob Ortt criticizes state policies and supports law enforcement and farmers in recent posts
M. H. Barr
Rob Ortt, Minority Leader in the New York State Senate and decorated Afghanistan veteran, recently posted a series of tweets addressing state policy issues, law enforcement, and agriculture.
On July 28, 2026, Ortt criticized state Democrats for economic policies. He wrote, "Albany Democrats preach affordability, but make life more expensive. Their failed policies drive up utility bills with costly green scam mandates and hike taxes through out of control spending. The @NYSenateGOP fights to put money back in your pocket and make NY affordable again".
Later that day, he commented on law enforcement actions in New York, "What world are we living in that our state leaders are taking stronger enforcement action against local sheriffs than they do against illegal immigrants? This is insanity. I stand strong with local law enforcement."
On July 29, 2026, Ortt expressed appreciation for farmers' contributions: "For their hard work in fields, barns, and everywhere in between, thank you farmers for putting food on our table."
Ortt has been recognized for his service to veterans and middle-income families. He has focused on veteran reintegration and support for post-traumatic stress as outlined on his official website. He received the Bronze Star for his military service in Afghanistan. Additionally, Ortt specialized in assisting middle-income families with debt reduction and retirement planning before entering public office. His political career includes serving as the first official to hold the combined title of Clerk-Treasurer in North Tonawanda.
